l0.speaker: narrator
l0.text: Sunday night in your dorm room. Quack is sitting on your pillow like it owns the place.

l1.speaker: quack
l1.text: Four weeks in, {player}! Let's see how everyone's doing. I've been keeping notes. Ducks are very observant.

l2.speaker: quack
l2.text: Keep showing up for lessons, and they'll keep showing up for you. Goodnight!
